title: Layer accordion reveal (Springs interiors)
source: springs.estate interiors. Engine = library/components/layer-accordion-reveal (proven, open/rest). Dual wrapper adds forceMotion + mobile swipe-slider.
engine: N big renders as vertical slabs, one open at a time; at rest each is a narrow strip, the open one expands to a near-full render with label+spec (clip-path inset + translateX, NO width tween). Engine exposes open(i)/rest().
differs: Same expand mechanic (clip-path inset + translateX) + same open(i). INTERACTION differs: desktop opens a slab on HOVER (engine wires mouseenter/focus/mouseleave); mobile has no hover, so the branch keeps the LIVE accordion (forceMotion) and drives the same open(i) via SWIPE + auto-cycle — turning the hover-rack into a swipe-slider. Springs presents interiors as a slider on mobile, a hover-rack on desktop.

desktop.driver: hoverNav — the engine already wires hover/focus/mouseleave; nothing extra.

mobile.driver: swipeSlider — touch-swipe → open(next/prev) + setInterval auto-cycle (pauses after a swipe). forceMotion keeps the accordion live on touch.

openFlex.what: open slab width as a fraction of the rack.

defaultIndex.what: which slab is open at rest (-1 = even).

engine_patch: forceMotion (skip the hover:none static fallback so the accordion stays LIVE on touch). reduced-motion still honored. Additive & opt-in; default desktop/reduced behavior unchanged. See memory dual-platform-forcemotion.
entry: LayerAccordionRevealDual.init(target, opts) -> { platform, engine, driver, count }. Load engine.js THEN component.js. target = the .lar-rack; pass panels:[{img,label,kicker,spec}] (engine builds the slabs).
law: transform (translateX) + clip-path (inset) + opacity + filter transition ONLY; width:100% on every slab is FIXED and never animated; NO width/height/top animation; NO WebGL. reduced-motion → static labelled list.
